methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College partners with Google for free AI training - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College partnering with Google for free AI training represents peer-network capacity building in a non-metro region, potentially distributing foundational AI literacy beyond the NoVA-Richmond corridor if sustained.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: A Norfolk native delivering free AI workshops specifically to 'close the technology gap' signals grassroots capability distribution in Hampton Roads, creating pathways for deep learning outside traditional tech hubs through community-driven education.

signals.title: Virginia Tech sets course for human-centered AI leadership - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's 'human-centered AI leadership' initiative concentrates advanced AI research capacity in Blacksburg, deepening expertise in one regional anchor institution but requiring deliberate knowledge transfer to prevent a Pockets of Excellence lock-in.

signals.title: Camp Welcomes Hampton Roads Youth to Learn About Cybersecurity and AI - Old Dominion University
signals.signal_reading: Old Dominion hosting youth camps on cybersecurity and AI builds early-stage distributed capability in Hampton Roads, signaling investment in regional talent pipelines that could prevent capability concentration if graduates remain local.

signals.title: How Virginia keeps tabs on cybersecurity threats as AI takes hold - VPM
signals.signal_reading: Virginia's statewide cybersecurity monitoring as AI proliferates reveals concentrated defensive capability in Richmond government centers, but effectiveness depends on whether security expertise diffuses to localities or remains centralized in the capital.
